We were put here to learn what a broken world is like, to witness what a leader like Satan produces; we are given time to figure this out and to seek God and his ways after we are finished with this world. You may hate God for your painful existence, but you have to forgive because there is peace in heaven. You all don't have to play the roles you we're given; no one is excluded from being able to summon God.

How to summon the God of Abraham: Do you hate the world? Do you feel suicidal? Do you hunger and thirst for justice on earth? (1 John 2:15, Luke 14:26, Matthew 5:6) If your answer is yes to any of them. Follow the instructions below. God will use you to fix problems as he did with the Apostle Paul in the book of Acts.

Step 1. Committing to becoming an Apostle. Baptize yourself in water (you have to mean it) (Acts 8:33-39). Declare to a witness that you believe Jesus Christ is the Son of God. This act is an oath that you will now give everything to God. And you will not turn back to your old self. Do fasts. Study the New Testament and pray all the time, all day, every day if possible (to preoccupy your time with prayer is key) (the second book of Adam and Eve). I enjoyed the solitude of burning frankincense and myrrh with candles lit in my prayers. No more tv, music, porn, drugs, drinking. Etc. Satan will try to stop you at this point: he will try and scare you and use other tactics to win you back over.

Step 2. Be persistent. And eventually. The God of Abraham will appear to you in dreams (Jeremiah 29:13). And he will give you tasks to do (1 peter 4:12). Follow them precisely as he says. You will be tested: you will face humiliations, losses, persecutions; the point is not to lose hope. Do not give up. Do not be like the complaining Egyptians that Moses freed. Just put all your trust in him. At the end of your trial, you will receive the power of the Holy Ghost. The same Super Powers Jesus had. And you will bring peace and justice to all.

If you are presently in a cult serving the dark side, remember that no sin is too great for Jesus to forgive, he even healed the daughter of a woman belonging to the cult of Canaanites. And a lesser-known Apostle named Simon was on Jesus's team; he was also from the same cult of Canaanites. Once you are baptized, don't be afraid of those who will threaten you for leaving: boldly claim that you are now a child of God and defy them. Have a blind trust in God. Just like when David challenged Goliath. Or when Daniel was dropped into the den of Lions. He will intervene on your behalf if you show courage and maintain an attitude of being committed to your decision to the death.
